summary: Xometry, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an underwriting agreement for an underwritten public offering of 2,647,059 shares of Class A common stock at $85.00 per share, with an underwriters' option for an additional 397,058 shares. J.P. Morgan and Goldman Sachs are representatives of the underwriters. Net proceeds are estimated at approximately $215.2 million, with closing expected June 3, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown under an existing automatic shelf registration statement, not a special-situation event. No premium, board recommendation, or strategic implications are present.
